I work across the full analytical process: defining the question, preparing and validating data, designing experiments, evaluating models, interpreting results, and communicating what the evidence supports.

<p class="project-type">Advanced analytics · Decision science</p>

### Freight Cost & Sampling Analysis

A 500,000-trip study showing how sampling design, confounding controls, and route segmentation change the operational conclusions available from freight data.

<div class="project-metric"><strong>0.991</strong><span>controlled load–cost correlation</span></div>

<p class="project-tools">Python · Statistical analysis · Segmentation</p>

[View repository →](https://github.com/JacobWillson13/freight-cost-analysis)
:::

::: {.project-card}
<p class="project-type">Experimental design · LLM evaluation</p>

### Gemma 4 Security-Advisory Evaluation

A controlled local experiment measuring how model size, supplied evidence, reasoning configuration, and temperature affect accuracy, latency, and reliability.

<div class="project-metric"><strong>3,900</strong><span>retained evaluation runs</span></div>

<p class="project-tools">Python · R · Ollama · ANOVA</p>

[View repository →](https://github.com/JacobWillson13/gemma4-eval)
:::

::: {.project-card}

<div class="project-metric"><strong>6,672</strong><span>question-level evaluation records</span></div>
